description: Search contacts with the Freshdesk query DSL. The query VALUE is wrapped in double quotes automatically. Examples: `name:'ada'`, `email:'ada@example.com'`, `company_id:123`. Freshdesk REST: GET /search/contacts.

page.description: Page number (1-10; search endpoints return 30 results per page and ignore per_page).

query.description: Freshdesk search query, e.g. "company_id:123" (do NOT add surrounding quotes yourself — they are added for you).

name: freshdesk_search_contacts
title: Search contacts
